about: Which config.json keys spell each field, in the order they are tried. The one copy both config readers use: crit_core.model.config loads it, core/CMakeLists.txt generates the C++ reader's arrays from it. A model family that spells a field its own way adds its key here, never a branch in a reader. layer_count_from: per-layer lists whose length is the layer count when num_hidden_layers is absent (configs that derive the count from them). full_attention_*: the geometry of full-attention layers where it differs from the other attention layers' (num_key_value_heads, head_dim), and a flag that their keys and values are one cached tensor; only the Python attention rules (attention_geometry, attention_shape, kv_elements_per_token) read them, the C++ reader types no attention geometry.
